title: SOS cancel-path test gaps: stale-seq replay, rate-budget neutrality, routing discrimination
description: python/tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py TestSosPutDelete: (1) the replay/stale-sequence gate on the POST-cancel path (emergency.py:304) is untested — after a successful cancel the resource is idle so naive replay hits 404; needs re-activate-then-replay-cancel (expect UNAUTHORIZED). (2) No test that cancel does not consume the rate budget (activate -> POST-cancel -> immediate re-activate within burst should be CREATED). (3) test_post_cancel_by_non_originator_rejected passes with AND without the fix (activate path also rejects wrong-key bodies) — it cannot discriminate routing; acceptable, but note it in a comment or use a distinguishing observable.
